subject: System Design
title: gRPC and Protocol Buffers
description: A fast breakdown of gRPC and Protocol Buffers for builders.

hook.text: REST sends data as human-readable JSON. gRPC sends compact binary — up to 10x smaller and faster.

buildup.text: gRPC uses Protocol Buffers to serialize data into tiny binary payloads with strict schemas.

discovery.text: It supports streaming, bidirectional communication, and auto-generated client libraries in any language.

twist.text: gRPC isn't browser-friendly. It's dominant for service-to-service calls but rare for public APIs.

climax.text: gRPC is the go-to for internal microservice communication where speed and type safety matter most.

punchline.text: Binary beats JSON when machines talk to machines.
